name: Mobile & Field Experience
summary: Mobile-first BPMN task execution and process initiation, field evidence, operator incident triage and policy-driven alarming, with safe offline synchronization and optional large-tablet BPMN authoring.
next_action: Execute MFE0 hardware acceptance runbook (docs/planning/mfe0-device-validation-runbook.md), record device/zoom/accessibility/privacy evidence in #1451, review blockers and formally hand off. MFE1 #1456 and MFE2 #1457 are scoped but planned until the gate is met; MFE3/MFE4/MFE5 retain separate ADR gates.

slices.title: Architecture and real-device baseline
slices.note: ADR-0514 accepted; PRs #1448/#1449/#1452/#1453/#1454 merged, with successful PR CI on #1453/#1454. Hardware runbook in docs/planning/mfe0-device-validation-runbook.md defines remaining real iOS/Android, 200% zoom, assistive technology and foldable evidence (#1451). MFE0 remains active, not complete.

slices.title: Mobile Tasks and Process Start
slices.note: Scoped in issue #1456: first mobile Tasks/Start vertical TDD slice using current HTTP API and form-js. Planned, unassigned, blocked on MFE0 hardware evidence and owner-approved handoff.

slices.title: Mobile incident triage
slices.note: Scoped in issue #1457: operator-only, bounded, read-only cause-grouped incident view. Planned, unassigned, blocked on MFE0 device/security handoff; no new alarm acknowledgement.

slices.title: Incident alerting and escalation
slices.note: Design secure deduplicated durable-fact alerts, acknowledgement/ownership ADR, monitored escalation and fallback without a second notification engine.

slices.title: Field capture and evidence
slices.note: Camera, QR/barcode, staged evidence with validated durable references outside process variables and WAL.

slices.title: Offline drafts and synchronization
slices.note: Secure drafts, completion operation IDs, server-side dedup/status checks, conflict handling and restart/replay tests; no premature success display.

slices.title: Optional large-tablet BPMN authoring
slices.note: Reuse bpmn-js with adaptive inspection and touch/pen modelling only where real-device validation supports it.
